By now, most people know all about microplastics and how they make their way into our homes. I’m a big proponent of sustainability, and have been for years — and a great place to make some easy swaps that are better for you and the planet is in the kitchen. In my own kitchen I’ve swapped paper towels for un-paper towels, paper napkins for cloth, and plastic food storage containers for glass ones.

Thankfully there are plenty of plastic-free food storage containers available, and there’s no better time to stock up on them than Black Friday and Cyber Monday. You can score some pretty great deals, like up to 50% off Stasher. Plus, you’ll only need to buy these items once and you’re set for life.

Professional chefs swear by deli containers, and thanks to Anyday those containers just got the plastic-free treatment. Anyday’s Anydeli mixed set is made from non-toxic platinum silicone, and is microwave-, freezer-, oven-, and dishwasher-safe. Each one has measurements on the side, and the lids have a stainless steel-enforced rim. Plus, they’ve got a little hole for ventilation and come in an array of fun colors. I’ve never had any issues with these items staining or leaking. They’re currently 15% off, with up to 40% off sitewide.

Ditch plastic bags forever with a set of Stashers. Made from food-grade platinum silicone and free from BPA, BPS, lead, latex, and phthalates, these bags are endlessly reusable. They’re also dishwasher-, microwave-, and oven-safe up to 425ºF. I use them constantly, and they come in a variety of fun colors and sizes, including snack, sandwich, half-gallon, and even stand-up bowls. No need to worry about spills, thanks to their pinch-loc seal. You can currently get them up to 50% off.

Glass isn’t the only sustainable alternative. Misen’s stainless steel containers do the job just as well and surprisingly are also safe for the oven, microwave, grill, freezer, and dishwasher. These containers are leakproof, platinum-cured, and come with super-durable universal silicone lids. Measurements are engraved on the inside of each container. Stock up on the mixed set now for up to 25% off.
